Yes, this works well. Clicking "Edit" opens up the title and description for me to revise, and the site name, its icon, and the picture stay put — which is right, since those are the parts the app fetches and I wouldn't want to fuss with them. The clear "Edit" button sitting right on the card is easy to spot, and I like that it's an obvious, deliberate way in rather than something hidden.

This first approach feels good to me. Go ahead and show me the alternatives so I can compare.
